description: A few words from a past client. Replace the demo quotes with real ones before launch.

id.label: ID
id.help: Made from the name. No need to change it.

name.label: Client Name
name.help: The name to show, e.g. Priya and Sam. Ask the client how they would like to be named.

context.label: Session
context.help: What you shot together, e.g. Family session at Larrabee.

quote.label: Quote
quote.help: Their words, lightly trimmed if you need to. Two or three sentences read best.

featured.label: Show on Home Page
featured.help: Turn on to use this quote on the home page. The first one by order is shown.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.

formgrid:
name id
context context
quote quote
featured order
updated created
